exposure: Society of Thoracic Surgeons-European Association (STAT) Score Categories
intensive care and hospital stay durations
cohort: The study included 2307 pediatric patients who underwent congenital heart surgery across 12 centers in Turkey between January 2018 and March 2020.
finding: The analysis of the CKCV Database found an overall mortality rate of 6.0%, with significant variations across different Modified Aristotle Comprehensive (MACC) and STAT Score Categories, ranging from 0.3% in MACC category I to 55.6% in MACC category VI.
